figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 41 for the place of the new moon: the circle of the horizon about ه with its upright diameter from ا (the south, at the top) to ج (the north, at the foot) and its level diameter from ب (the east, at the left) to د (the west, at the right); an arc inside the circle from ب over the upright diameter, above the letter ل, to د; an oblique line from the circle at the upper right, beside ح, through ز, the arc at ط, the centre ه and the circle again at ك, on to a smaller circle at the lower left, through its centre to its far side at م; and in the smaller circle a line across the oblique one, from ع to س; with the words «الجنوب», «المغرب», «المشرق» and «الشمال» at the top, the right, the left and the foot. Measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi (scratch fig/spec1015.json): the two circles and the four lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths); each line is drawn between its meetings with the fitted circles. The arc is a least-squares circle through its own ink (scratch fig/arc1015.py: the ink above the level diameter, away from the circle, the two lines that cross it and the letter ط), drawn between its meetings with the circle of the horizon. The seventeen letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink; ط, which touches the crossing of the arc and the oblique line, at the centre of its ink away from them

corrections: p. 137: the figure stands at the left of the page beside lines 14 to 22, which begin at 413 to 416 pt; lines 1 to 12 run across the page over it, line 13 ends a paragraph at 208 pt and line 14, the first of the next, is set in (it ends at 519 pt). The automatic geometry took the labels of the figure for parts of the lines, missed the last line and took the first letter of line 20 for a margin item: the 22 lines are measured from their ink (scratch geom1015.py); the rule and the margin items (line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 at the right, one folio number at the left) are those of the automatic geometry; the two note lines and the printer's signature at the foot (two digits, 507.6 to 515.9 pt, their feet at 764.8 pt) are measured from their ink; the figure is redrawn (F01)
